alert_news.title: India's First AI‑Powered Locomotive Developed at Patiala
bullets: India’s first AI‑powered locomotive, built by Patiala Locomotive Works (PLW) in Punjab, equipped with an AI‑based Overhead Equipment monitoring system.
Locomotive number 39642, a WP‑7 passenger electric engine, flagged off as part of a pilot project of four engines, enabling predictive fault detection of overhead power lines.
The AI system continuously monitors overhead power lines and tracks, identifying potential faults before major problems occur.

alert_news.title: M1xchange Becomes India's First TReDS Platform with CGTMSE Guarantee Cover
bullets: M1xchange became the first TReDS platform in India to go live with CGTMSE guarantee cover, enabling credit‑guaranteed receivables financing for MSMEs.
The first CGTMSE‑backed TReDS transaction was completed on the platform, digitizing the entire guarantee journey via APIs for real‑time cover calculation.
Collaboration between the Ministry of MSME, CGTMSE, and M1xchange strengthens liquidity access for MSMEs and encourages participation of financiers.

alert_news.title: CMF and Optiemus Build India's First End‑to‑End Smartphone R&D Capability
bullets: CMF (Nothing) and Optiemus partnership establishes India’s first full‑stack, end‑to‑end smartphone research and development capability, covering design, engineering, software, connectivity, and component engineering.
The initiative brings manufacturing, ownership, and R&D under a single Indian entity, moving beyond assembly to local technology development and IP generation.
The partnership aims to expand India’s role in the smartphone value chain from manufacturing to technology development and global exports.

alert_news.title: Safdarjung Hospital hosts India's first robotic cardiac surgery workshop
bullets: India’s first workshop dedicated solely to robotic cardiac surgery, held at Safdarjung Hospital, New Delhi, organized by VMMC and Safdarjung Hospital.
Two live robotic cardiac surgeries performed and over seven hours of hands‑on simulation sessions during the two‑day workshop (17–18 September 2026).
Workshop focused on advanced robotic intracardiac techniques, enhancing training for cardiac surgeons across India.

alert_news.title: India's first blue bond set for launch next week, official says
bullets: India’s first blue bond issued by Sagarmala Finance Corporation, a maritime lender, to raise 6 billion rupees (US$62.6 million) via a 10‑year bond.
Proceeds earmarked for maritime sector lending, greenfield port projects, coastal road network and other sustainable water and marine initiatives.

alert_news.title: NIT Srinagar Set To Become India's First NIT With Dedicated Astronomy Observatory ...
bullets: NIT Srinagar will inaugurate the Observatory for Astronomy and Astrophysics, becoming the first NIT in India to have a dedicated campus observatory.
The observatory houses a 14‑inch Celestron C14 EdgeHD Schmidt‑Cassegrain telescope, enabling advanced astrophotography, research and student training.

alert_news.title: India’s first Coastal Green Shipping Corridor between Kandla and Thoothukudi
bullets: First Coastal Green Shipping Corridor in India, linking Kandla (Gujarat) to Thoothukudi (Tamil Nadu) under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
Operated by two vessels each with a minimum capacity of 1,000 TEUs, 14‑day round‑trip voyage, weekly frequency, project cost estimated at Rs 150 crore

alert_news.title: India’s First Asian Games Medal in Mixed Martial Arts
bullets: India won its first-ever Asian Games medal in mixed martial arts (MMA) when Suchika Tariyal secured a bronze in the women’s traditional –60 kg category at the Aichi‑Nagoya Asian Games 2026.
The medal was earned in the inaugural MMA event at the Asian Games, marking the first time MMA was contested as a medal sport.

alert_news.title: Suchika Tariyal secures India's first Asian Games medal in MMA
bullets: India's first Asian Games medal in mixed martial arts (women's 60 kg) won by Suchika Tariyal at Nagoya 2026
Achievement marks India's debut podium finish in MMA at the Asian Games

alert_news.title: Bharat Future City to become India's first net‑zero, AI‑enabled green megacity
bullets: India's first net‑zero, AI‑enabled green megacity – Bharat Future City – being built in Telangana over 30,000 acres
Project aims to integrate AI, clean‑tech parks, world‑class universities and sustainable residential zones as a model for future cities
